newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLO market awaits exchange auction.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLO market awaits exchange auction.

text.p: Front-month Belgian linear bond futures closed unchanged with just 351 lots traded on Wednesday, ahead of a four-day holiday. Bond markets will be closed on Thursday and Friday for the Ascension holiday.
Dealers said there had been virtually no trade as many investors had already squared their books earlier this week.

Tuesday's OLO exchange auction will be the main feature early next week. The Treasury is expected to try and auction a lot of the May 25, 1997 OLO, which is up for exchange the last time before final maturity.
